analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see decision maintained. ADX at 9.3 indicates no trend formation, and RSI at 50.2 remains in neutral territory. While MACD histogram shows improvement, it's insufficient to signal a trend reversal. The price closed down -3.69% over 5 days but remains above the 20-day low. Expecting a range-bound movement between the swing support at 1,690,000 KRW and resistance at 1,890,000 KRW, with the current price at 1,773,000 KRW.
